simple.meaning: מוֹרַשְׁתִּי (Môwrashtîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Morashtite or inhabitant of Moresheth-Gath.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מוֹרַשְׁתִּי (H4183) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Jeremiah 26:18, with occurrences in Jeremiah, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוֹרַשְׁתִּי (H4183) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מוֹרַשְׁתִּי (H4183) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מוֹרַשְׁתִּי (Môwrashtîy) / H4183 is traced through Jeremiah 26:18, Micah 1:1 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
